description: Lists videos in a client site's library (newest first), optionally filtered by a title search. Use it to find video ids for get_embed_code or add_videos_to_showcase, or to check a video is already hosted before uploading it again. Paged: pass nextCursor for more.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous call, e.g. "eyJpZCI6IjAxOTAifQ".

search.description: Text in the video title, e.g. "hero".

siteId.description: Client site id from list_sites, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

name: list_videos
title: List videos
